text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Suboptimal Intake Jaundice). The total bilirubin of 16.1 mg/dL with a normal direct fraction indicates unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia, and the absence of clay-colored stool or dark urine rules out biliary obstruction. Given the baby is 2 weeks old with a slight weight gain but exclusively breastfed, this suggests inadequate milk transfer rather than sepsis or anatomical issues.
